packageRules.description: Automatically merge minor and patch-level updates

Group RustCrypto digest-ecosystem crates so they upgrade in lockstep. The `digest` trait crate is shared by sha*, hmac, rsa, signature, etc., and a major bump of one (e.g. sha1 0.10 -> 0.11 moves to digest 0.11) breaks compilation against any sibling still on the old `digest` major. Keeping them in one PR forces them to land together.
